en: Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop complex with two tall, steep‑roofed towers and a massive rectangular main building, resembling a castle or fortified palace, overlooking a river. Below the castle are dense trees, a cobbled road leading through a stone arch, and a bridge structure in the foreground. Across the river is a riverside promenade lined with trees and a few houses, set against low wooded hills. The image has wide white margins and the framing typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.
